# MailVault

> MailVault is a free, private desktop email app for macOS, Windows and Linux. It reads, sends and searches mail from Gmail, Microsoft 365, Outlook.com and IMAP accounts, and keeps a copy of the messages you choose on your own computer as plain .eml files, even after you delete them from the server. There is no MailVault account and no MailVault server in the path of your mail. Premium ($4/month or $25/year) adds scheduled backups, tracker removal, Time Capsule, cleanup rules, migration, the one-step Archive & Delete and Archive, Back up & Delete (which also checks a copy on your backup drive before removing mail from the server), two whole-account jobs in Settings > Backup & Restore, Archive, back up & delete from server and Archive & delete from server (choose folders and years, every copy checked before anything leaves the server), Privacy mode (masks names, addresses and phone numbers in the app, with redacted and social image export), a check at Send for an attachment you mentioned but forgot, a reminder when a sent email gets no reply, and Hoarder, a download mode that keeps every folder's full history on the computer instead of a recent window.

## Email guides and research

- [Gmail third-party account changes before January 2027](https://mailvaultapp.com/blog/gmail-third-party-changes-2027.html): Gmailify, third-party Send as, and POP fetching changes; what remains supported and how to transition
- [Cloud versus local email search](https://mailvaultapp.com/blog/cloud-vs-local-email-search.html): AI search availability, local index coverage, offline retrieval, and diagrams showing where processing happens
- [Leaving an email provider safely](https://mailvaultapp.com/blog/leave-email-provider-safely.html): inventory, complete archives, attachment verification, independent backups, and testing before closing an account
- [Phishing beyond suspicious links](https://mailvaultapp.com/blog/phishing-beyond-suspicious-links.html): calendar invitations, QR codes, attached emails, independent verification, and incident reporting
- [Searching 50,000 emails in milliseconds](https://mailvaultapp.com/blog/search-50000-emails-in-milliseconds.html): measured search performance, SQLite FTS5, trigram indexing, and local search diagrams
